title: Zoho Books Nigeria E-Invoicing Setup #Shorts
description:
Learn how to configure the new Nigeria-specific tax and e-invoicing settings in Zoho Books for instant compliance.

1. Go to Settings in Zoho Books and select Taxes.
2. Enable the Nigeria tax module to access local compliance templates.
3. Set up the e-invoicing integration to automate tax document generation.

lines.say: Nigerian businesses often struggle with manual tax and e-invoicing compliance, leading to errors and lost time. Always check with your tax advisor regarding specific local filing requirements.

screen.heading: Taxes
toggles: Is your business registered for tax?
screen.tip: Open tax settings in Zoho Books.

lines.say: Open Zoho Books, click the Gear icon for Settings, then navigate to the Taxes and Compliance section to select Taxes.
lines.tts: Open Zoho Books, click the Gear icon for Settings, then navigate to the Taxes and Compliance section to select Taxes.

lines.say: Within the Tax settings, enable the Nigeria tax module. This allows you to input your tax registration details and access local compliance templates.

lines.say: Finally, go to Integrations to connect your e-invoicing portal. This automates tax document generation, ensuring your invoices meet local regulatory standards.
